question_text: Maria is a 38-year-old natural-born Filipino citizen who has been a resident of the Philippines for her entire life. She holds a bachelor's degree in political science and has worked as a legislative aide for 10 years. She wants to run for Senator in the upcoming national elections. Which of the following statements about her qualifications is correct?

options.text: Maria is qualified because she meets all the constitutional requirements: natural-born citizen, at least 35 years old, able to read and write, and a resident for at least 2 years.
Maria is not qualified because she lacks the required 5 years of residency in the Philippines immediately preceding the election.
Maria is not qualified because she is only 38 years old, and the minimum age for Senators is 40.
Maria is qualified only if she has been a resident of the district she intends to represent for at least 1 year.
